page_title: BHA 2-1 BOU | Brighton v Bournemouth 25/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' A yellow card for a tackle by Mats Wieffer (Brighton). Michael Oliver doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+6' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+6' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+5' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Georginio Rutter did his best and is replaced by Solly March (Brighton).
87' The corner from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is cleared away by the defence.
87' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
85' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mats Wieffer (Brighton) replacing Carlos Baleba.
85' Substitution. James Hill walks off the pitch and Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.

84' A sweet pass finds Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Bart Verbruggen is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
82' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
82' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Bournemouth are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
81' The resulting corner, taken by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), comes to nothing.
81' A dangerous looking corner kick from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is cleared to safety by the defence.
79' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Dango Ouattara and he is replaced by Evanilson (Bournemouth).

75' 2 - 1 Georginio Rutter passes the ball into the penalty area. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom right corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:1!
75' A cross from Yasin Ayari (Brighton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Gomez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
72' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Pervis Estupinan is replaced by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton).
72' That will be all from Joao Pedro who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Danny Welbeck (Brighton).
71' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
69' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
69' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
68' The resulting corner from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is cleared.
65' A clever short pass gives Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
64' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is teed up on the edge of the box by Milos Kerkez, and his howitzer of a shot inside the right post gives the keeper no chance. 1:1.
61' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Diego Gomez (Brighton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
60' The foul by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Oliver.
59' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
56' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Oliver didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
53' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
53' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
53' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
52' A brilliant individual effort! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post.
51' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
48' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece. Brighton will take a free kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Andoni Iraola probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of David Brooks (Bournemouth). He is replaced by Marcus Tavernier.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Michael Oliver blows for a foul after Georginio Rutter (Brighton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick is awarded to Bournemouth.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' The cross into the penalty area from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
42' The referee awards a corner and Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) goes over to take it.
41' The ball is cleared after Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
37' A great pass puts Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.

34' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Bart Verbruggen makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
32' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' The corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is hurriedly cleared.
27' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Brighton are awarded a free kick.
26' Problems for Andoni Iraola as Ryan Christie is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Alex Scott (Bournemouth) replaces him.
24' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call. Brighton have a free kick.
22' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is able to continue to play.
21' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

18' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
17' A pass into the penalty area from Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
15' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
15' David Brooks (Bournemouth) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball. Bournemouth earn a corner.
14' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Oliver saw the whole situation. Bournemouth win a free kick.
14' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Joao Pedro (Brighton) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Kepa Arrizabalaga no chance!
12' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is going to take the penalty!
11' Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. That's a penalty to Brighton! They have a good chance to score now.

10' Kaoru Mitoma almost found himself in a promising position after Diego Gomez (Brighton) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
9' Adam Webster (Brighton) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well wide of the right post!
9' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga is quickest to intercept the ball.
8' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Michael Oliver couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Brighton.

2' A pass travels right across the box to Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the right post, but Bart Verbruggen denies him with a decent save.
1' The match has just started.
Brighton will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
